newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Malev sees '96 profit of HUF 350-400 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Malev sees '96 profit of HUF 350-400 mln.

text.p: Hungary's national airline Malev Rt said it expected a 1996 pre-tax profit of between 350 million to 400 million forints, Malev said on Friday.
This is more than double of the 1995 profit, the company said.
Malev had 56 billion forints turnover in 1996 and had 1.6 million passengers, it added.
The company plans to increase the passenger number by some eight percent this year and also plans boost its sales by some 25 percent, Malev said.
Malev, which has an issued share capital of 77 billion forints, is 35 percent owned by Italy's Alitalia while most of the remaining stake is held by Hungary's state privatisation agency APV Rt.
